sections.title: Warm-up
sections.notes: Rope, then dynamic stretching; finish with 20 s of fast feet.

sections.title: Footwork
sections.notes: Step-in / step-back / pivot ladder drills; partner mirrors to keep distance.

sections.title: Counters
sections.notes: Partner throws roundhouse; defender slides back and counters.

sections.title: Controlled rounds
sections.notes: 3 × 90 s rounds, rotate partners; coaches call out ring position.

sections.title: Cool-down
sections.notes: Stretch, bow out, one takeaway each.

plans.name: Sparring block · week 2: counters under pressure

sections.title: Timing
sections.notes: Pad holder feeds; students pick cut kick or back kick counter.

sections.title: Ring craft
sections.notes: Start near the edge; escape with a feint and switch.

sections.title: Rounds
sections.notes: Point rounds with a scorer; review two exchanges per pair.
